int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
int iteration = 3;
int visited[400];

int n, t;
int augment(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
    if (cnode == dest) return bneck;
    if (visited[cnode] == iteration) return 0;
    visited[cnode] = iteration;
    for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
        if (cap[cnode][i] > 0) {
            int flow = augment(i, dest, min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]));
            if (flow > 0) {
                cap[cnode][i] -= flow;
                cap[i][cnode] += flow;
                return flow;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int getNode(int x, int y) {
    return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
}

int reach[13][13], treach[13][13];

void expand(int val) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {

                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

        expand(1);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
        expand(2);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
    }
    return false;
}

    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        scanf(" %s", scien[i] + 1);

            if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {

                }

        }
    }

                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int src = n * n * 2 + 1;

                cap[n * n + getNode(i, j)][dest] = reac[i][j] - '0';
            }
            if (isdigit(scien[i][j])) {
                for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                    for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                        if (scien[i][j] > '0' && reac[ki][kj] > '0') {
